Comments: Multiple partial data exchange systems operational: Treasury Secure Data Facility (SDF), SASSA SRD370 system, National Strategic Hub (CoGTA), South African Integrated Data Lake. Whole-of-government real-time data exchange (Initiative 2 of the Digital Transformation Roadmap) is under active development via Inter-Departmental Working Group (IDWG) established September 2024. Full unified exchange hub not yet operational.
